source: Claude external audit supplied by user
accepted_findings: The preregistered adjacent-lineage screen correctly resolves to NO_SCREEN_SUPPORT because the primary absolute-bodyweight-change coefficient is negative/non-significant and the fixed extreme-band direction is also opposite the support direction.
The T011/T009-parent result must not be generalized to T009R; it is candidate triage only.
The signed bodyweight-change association is secondary/exploratory and must not be promoted post hoc to primary evidence or feature-adoption evidence.
The absolute bodyweight-change hypothesis is weakened/rejected within this adjacent-lineage screen, but not proven absent in exact T009R.
